models.role: video matte generation using Stable Video Diffusion with mask conditioning
models.license_summary: CC BY-NC 4.0; non-commercial use only. Commercial production use is not cleared. Both model weights and pipeline code are user-managed.
models.warning_text: NON-COMMERCIAL: VideoMaMa is CC BY-NC 4.0 licensed. Visible warning required. Commercial production use is not cleared. Pipeline code and model weights are user-managed manual downloads — NOT bundled by default.
models.output_use_notes: Generates video alpha matte sequences from source frames and a first-frame mask (or per-frame mask sequence) using SVD-based diffusion. Supports per-frame tracked masks via mask_sequence_pattern. Non-commercial license applies. Pipeline code and model weights must be manually downloaded and configured by the user.

multi_source_payload.description: VideoMaMa requires TWO model sources merged into a single directory AND user-downloaded pipeline code. The model manager cannot auto-install multi-source; manual setup is required.

sources.instructions: User must download pipeline_svd_mask_numpy.py from the VideoMaMa repo and either place it next to model weights, set FLUX_VIDEOMAMA_CODE_ROOT, or add to PYTHONPATH.

source.notes: VideoMaMa cannot be installed by a single-source download. It requires merging SVD base model from stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt (provides vae/, scheduler/, feature_extractor/, image_encoder/, model_index.json) with the VideoMaMa fine-tuned UNet from SammyLim/VideoMaMa (provides unet/). Both must be placed under ~/.local/share/Flux/models/videomama/<dir>/ with model_index.json, unet/config.json, and vae/config.json present. Pipeline code (pipeline_svd_mask_numpy.py) is NOT bundled — user must download from https://github.com/SammyLim/VideoMaMa and place it next to model weights, set FLUX_VIDEOMAMA_CODE_ROOT, or add to PYTHONPATH.

fallback.notes: Download the VideoMaMa UNet weights and pipeline_svd_mask_numpy.py from the SammyLim/VideoMaMa repo and the SVD base model from stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt. Merge unet/ from VideoMaMa into the SVD base model directory. Place pipeline_svd_mask_numpy.py next to the merged model or set FLUX_VIDEOMAMA_CODE_ROOT.
